parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default: 1)

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page (default: 10)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix - for descending. Allowed: id, status, fulfillment_type, tracking_number, cost, fulfilled_at, packing_slip_printed_at, created_at, updated_at

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Archived scope. 'only' = archived only, 'all' = include both, omit/anything else = exclude archived (default)

parameters.name: filter[packing_slip_printed]
parameters.description: Packing slip printed scope: 'yes'/'1'/true or 'no'/'0'/false

parameters.name: filter[integration_instance_ids]
parameters.description: Comma-separated integration instance IDs (matches via salesOrder.salesChannel.integration_instance_id)

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Top-bar search across tracking_number, fulfillment_number, salesOrder.sales_order_number, customer.name, warehouse.name, and product SKU. Append .strict for exact match (e.g. filter[search.strict])

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Fulfillment status. Operators: is, is_not, contains, does_not_contain, is_one_of, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty. Use filter[status.operator] for explicit op.

parameters.name: filter[fulfillment_type]
parameters.description: Fulfillment type (shipstation, shipfusion, fba, etc.). Same operator suffixes as status.

parameters.name: filter[tracking_number]
parameters.description: Tracking number. Text operators supported (is, contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, etc.)

parameters.name: filter[requested_shipping_method]
parameters.description: Requested shipping method. Matches FK shippingMethod.full_name or raw text override column. Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[fulfilled_shipping_method]
parameters.description: Fulfilled shipping method. Matches FK fulfilledShippingMethod.full_name or manual_fulfilled_shipping_method text. Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[backordered]
parameters.description: Backorder state filter. Value is a JSON object: { state: 'yes'|'no'|'released_by_po', po_number?: string }. Operator must be 'is' (use filter[backordered.is]).

parameters.name: filter[warehouse]
parameters.description: Warehouse ID. Matches via warehouse relationship (id column).

parameters.name: filter[id.greater_than]
parameters.description: Internal fulfillment ID. Numeric operators: is, is_not, is_one_of, greater_than, less_than, greater_than_or_equal, less_than_or_equal, between, is_empty, is_not_empty.

parameters.name: filter[fulfillment_sequence]
parameters.description: Fulfillment sequence number within its sales order. Numeric operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[fulfillment_number]
parameters.description: Computed accessor '{sales_order_number}.{fulfillment_sequence}'. The filter splits on the dot and matches each part. Text operators supported on the order-number portion.

parameters.name: filter[customer_reference]
parameters.description: Sales Order # (matches salesOrder.sales_order_number). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_name]
parameters.description: Customer name (salesOrder.customer.name). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_email]
parameters.description: Customer email (salesOrder.customer.email). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_phone]
parameters.description: Customer phone (salesOrder.customer.phone). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_company]
parameters.description: Customer company (salesOrder.customer.company). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_address]
parameters.description: Customer shipping address line 1 (salesOrder.shippingAddress.address1). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_city]
parameters.description: Customer shipping city (salesOrder.shippingAddress.city). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_province]
parameters.description: Customer shipping state/province (salesOrder.shippingAddress.province). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_province_code]
parameters.description: Customer shipping state/province code (salesOrder.shippingAddress.province_code). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_zip]
parameters.description: Customer shipping zip/postal code (salesOrder.shippingAddress.zip). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_country]
parameters.description: Customer shipping country (salesOrder.shippingAddress.country). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[customer_country_code]
parameters.description: Customer shipping country code (salesOrder.shippingAddress.country_code). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[store]
parameters.description: Store name (salesOrder.store.name). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[sales_channel_type_name]
parameters.description: Sales channel integration type (salesOrder.salesChannel.integrationInstance.integration.name). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[sales_order_shipping_method]
parameters.description: Sales order shipping method (salesOrder.shippingMethod.name). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[sales_order_tags]
parameters.description: Sales order tags (salesOrder.tags.name_en, MorphToMany). Text operators supported. Negative ops use whereDoesntHave.

parameters.name: filter[item_name]
parameters.description: Line item name/description (salesOrderFulfillmentLines.salesOrderLine.description). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[item_sku]
parameters.description: Line item SKU (salesOrderFulfillmentLines.salesOrderLine.product.sku). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[item_quantity.greater_than]
parameters.description: Fulfillment line quantity (salesOrderFulfillmentLines.quantity). Numeric operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[item_price.between]
parameters.description: Sales order line unit amount (salesOrderFulfillmentLines.salesOrderLine.amount). Numeric operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[item_nominal_code]
parameters.description: Line item nominal code (salesOrderFulfillmentLines.salesOrderLine.nominalCode.code). Text operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[cost.between]
parameters.description: Fulfillment cost. Numeric operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[fulfilled_at.between]
parameters.description: Fulfilled at datetime. Operators: is, is_not, greater_than, less_than, greater_than_or_equal, less_than_or_equal, between, is_empty, is_not_empty.

parameters.name: filter[packing_slip_printed_at.is_not_empty]
parameters.description: Packing slip printed at datetime. Datetime operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[created_at.greater_than]
parameters.description: Created at datetime. Datetime operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[updated_at.greater_than]
parameters.description: Updated at datetime. Datetime operators supported.

parameters.name: filter[archived_at.is_not_empty]
parameters.description: Archived at datetime (sales_order_fulfillments.archived_at). Datetime operators supported.

parameters.name: filter_groups
parameters.description: GroupedFilterSupport tree for nested AND/OR conditions. Each condition: { column, operator, value }. Allowed columns match filter[*] above.
